evidence.note: Clean serif title with sans subtitle and byline, generous whitespace; consistent header and section nav used on every slide.
Triangle loop diagram with coloured honest/cheat arrows and check badges sits cleanly beside the prose; definition tile placed directly under the diagram it explains.
Insight card over a blurred slide uses the same overlay treatment as s-4 step 7, giving a consistent component.
Shared servers/mirror/internet world with agent-run fan, numbered timeline left and quote tile right; uncluttered, tile is beside the diagram it narrates.

Final evaluation step is the busiest: folder grid, coordinator/sacrificed dots, scorer box overlapping run lines, and the 'never read transcripts' label runs past the server panel's right edge; dense but nothing illegible.
Coordinator tree card is tidy, but faint ghost elements peek out at its left edge and the quote tile floats low on the right, slightly detached.
Two takeaway cards with consistent serif heads, bullets and source lines; the right third of the slide is empty and blurred diagram remnants show behind the cards.
Close slide mirrors the title slide's treatment, bookending the deck consistently.

rationale: Type, colour, tiles, overlays and the shared incident diagram are applied consistently, and diagrams carry the narrative rather than decorating it. A couple of states fall below the rest: s-5 step 8 is dense with a label overrunning its panel, and s-9 leaves an unbalanced empty right third with background bleed. That fits 'considered throughout, with one or two slides below the rest'.
